name: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd
title: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd - 544608 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Solar module/cell maker with cell utilisation up to 69.9% (FY26) and 79% in Q4, but a 6 GW expansion adds capacity by FY27 and working capital absorbed INR636 crore of inventory build.

utilisation.quote: Solar cell capacity utilization increased from 43.3% in FY2025 to 69.9% in FY26.

capex.quote: we have initiated plans for our new 6 gigawatt integrated cell and module manufacturing facility

triggers.label: Cell utilisation 43.3% → 69.9%
triggers.quote: Solar cell capacity utilization increased from 43.3% in FY2025 to 69.9% in FY26.

triggers.label: 6 GW integrated expansion underway
triggers.quote: we have initiated plans for our new 6 gigawatt integrated cell and module manufacturing facility

triggers.label: Inventory build INR636 crore in FY26
triggers.quote: Out of that, INR636 crores has been produced and we have added to the inventory of modules and cells.

triggers.label: DCR and non-DCR pricing flat
triggers.quote: I'm not seeing that kind of a upward pricing as we speak.

guidance.metric: Installed module capacity by FY27 end
guidance.quote: this will take our total installed capacity to 16.3 gigawatt for modules and 8.9 gigawatt for cells by the end of FY2027
we are looking at like you know, a mix of between 30% to 35% of DCR
we are confident to keep that, you know, around the similar levels

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow weak vs EBITDA
red_flags.quote: after adjusting for the working capital movement, there is -- there has been a decline from INR625-odd crores to INR200 crores

red_flags.label: Advances from customers fell sharply
red_flags.quote: this year the advance is much lower

red_flags.label: Management evasive on sales volumes and mix
red_flags.quote: Usually, we don't give the sales megawatt that is done because it can just come into the calculations

red_flags.label: Module utilisation only 43%
red_flags.quote: Module utilization for FY2026 stood at 43%

evasions.quote: Usually, we don't give the sales megawatt that is done because it can just come into the calculations
Sometimes advances are taken in the form of LC, which is not usually reflected in the advance from customer part
